reserva.intro: One-to-one video lessons. Pick a slot, hold it with the deposit, and the link arrives by email. Three steps on the same screen.
reserva.paso1Texto: The calendar shows the teacher's free times in YOUR timezone, not his. He is in Switzerland and Costa Rica never changes its clocks, so that is a calculation you are better off not doing yourself.
reserva.paso2Texto: With PayPal, in the same step. The slot is not held until the payment goes through, so nobody can take it from you while you fill in your details.
reserva.paso3Texto: To whatever email you give, with a calendar invitation and a reminder before the lesson. The meeting link is created automatically; nobody has to email you for it.
reserva.avisoTerceros: The calendar is run by Calendly, a separate company. It loads from their servers when you scroll down to it, and they receive whatever you type in there: name, email and payment details. The rest of the page asks them for nothing.
reserva.pendienteTitulo: Online booking is not live yet
reserva.pendienteTexto: The Calendly account that will run the schedule, the payments and the Zoom links still has to be connected. We would rather say so than show you a calendar that holds nothing. In the meantime, write to us and we will sort it by hand.
reserva.depositoTexto: Charged when you book, to hold the lesson. The rest is settled directly with your teacher.

online.titulo: What an online lesson is like
online.intro: One-to-one video lessons with a Costa Rican teacher. He is based in Switzerland, so there are slots that work for both Europe and the Americas.
online.paso1Texto: Times are shown in your own zone and in Costa Rica's, so there are no surprises.
online.paso2Texto: With a PayPal deposit. You settle the rest directly with your teacher.
online.paso3Texto: You get the video call link. Lessons are conversation from day one, not exercise filler.

online.medidaCierre: The lesson adapts to your level, your goal and what interests you. Instead of a generic syllabus it is a conversation that goes where it needs to go.

costaRica.comoIntro: This is not a course you travel to: it is a trip you learn on. Three things, and they come together.
costaRica.claseTexto: Mornings, in small groups, at a local school with Costa Rican teachers. The Spanish they teach is the one you will hear the moment you step outside, not the textbook one.
costaRica.hospedajeTexto: The school sorts it, so you are not hunting for a place yourself or landing somewhere without knowing where you sleep. It is part of the immersion too: Spanish keeps going outside the classroom.
costaRica.viajeTexto: Afternoons and weekends are the country: the national park, the soda, the bus, the corner shop. That is where the morning's vocabulary turns into something that comes out on its own.
costaRica.destinosIntro: Each place has its own school and its own reason to pick it. Pick one and tell us what you are after.

about.heroAcento: A tico teaching you his Spanish.
about.heroSubtitulo: Textbooks teach you a Spanish nobody actually speaks. Costa Rica Spanish Experience exists to close that gap: real teachers, real slang, real voseo — the language you will hear the moment you land.
about.historiaTexto1: Every language app promises fluency and hands you the same neutral, textbook Spanish regardless of where you are headed. Land in Costa Rica with that Spanish and the first thing a local says back will not match a single lesson you took.
about.historiaTexto2: Costa Rica Spanish Experience starts from the opposite direction: it teaches the Spanish that is actually spoken here — the voseo, the tone, the slang — first, and the grammar to support it second. Online lessons come first because that is where most people are today; the immersion trips will build on the same idea once the destinations are ready.
about.historiaCita: Pura vida is not a phrase you memorise. It's a way people actually talk, and you cannot learn it from a textbook.
about.valoresTitulo: What makes a lesson here different
about.valoresIntro: Four things this school cares about more than a generic syllabus does.
about.valor1Texto: Voseo, slang and tone, taught on purpose — not skipped because a textbook does not cover them.
about.valor2Texto: Every lesson is one-to-one video with a real teacher who adjusts to how you actually talk and what you actually need.
about.valor3Texto: Slots shown in your own time zone, not the teacher's. You fit the lesson in — not the other way round.
about.valor4Texto: Online lessons are live today; the immersion trips across Costa Rica are being built with the same care, one confirmed detail at a time.

about.cierreTexto: Book a one-to-one lesson and find out how different it sounds from a textbook.
